COD.rationale: Content (color-coordinate mapping), its presentation as a current node, and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same referent.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content identifiers (color attributes) bound to coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata are provided separately from the content coordinate entries for the same nodes.

O.rationale: The text presents how content is organized across named nodes and candidate structures (current vs candidate nodes).
